name: zorskill
description: zorskill - AI-powered skill marketplace for Claude Code by ZorCorp

plugins.name: kf-cli
plugins.description: KnowledgeFactory CLI — AI-powered capture-to-publish pipeline for Obsidian. Capture videos (YouTube, Loom, Vimeo), articles, repos, and ideas into structured notes. Auto-tag, wiki-index, and publish. No Docker or MCP required.

plugins.name: cx-trip-pa
plugins.description: Search and book flights on Trip.com with agent-browser using the /flight command.

plugins.name: code-to-video
plugins.description: Turn existing web source code into a shareable Google Drive demo video — analyzes code, generates Stitch UI screens, renders a Remotion MP4, and uploads to Google Drive.

plugins.name: prototyper
plugins.description: Convert source code or Stitch UI designs into a standalone interactive HTML demo with auto-play, simulated cursor, and animations. Includes a built-in HKUST Store Virtual Try-On demo.

plugins.name: hermes-on-cf
plugins.description: Deploy your own Hermes Agent — a stateful AI agent reachable from your own Telegram bot — to your own Cloudflare account (Worker + Container + R2 + AI Gateway). Self-service: clone the kit, set your tokens in .env, run the deploy scripts.

plugins.name: openclaw-on-cf
plugins.description: Deploy your own OpenClaw bot — an AI agent with both a Telegram channel and a web dashboard — to your own Cloudflare account (Worker + Container + R2 + AI Gateway). Self-service: clone the kit, set your tokens in .env, run the deploy scripts.

plugins.name: yellow-restaurant
plugins.description: Find nearby yellow restaurants (黃店食肆) from the Yellow-Blue Map API using GPS coordinates.

plugins.name: zorskill-dev
plugins.description: Maintainer tooling for the zorskill marketplace: keep every plugin's version in sync, advance submodule pointers, and scaffold new plugins. Aggregation-side only.

plugins.name: fc-bms2
plugins.description: Query the Finda Cloud (FC) BMS operational database — orders, invoices, AR, gross profit, purchase orders, vendors, customers, products, exchange rates, sales attribution and the org chart — from its read-only BigQuery mirror behind a private Cloud Run endpoint. Read-only, skill-only: no MCP server, proxy or binary to install.

plugins.name: gcp-bq
plugins.description: Query GCP cloud cost — price and cost by billing account, project, service, or SKU, for one month or a range. Read-only, skill-only: signs a Google ID token with gcloud and curls a private Cloud Run endpoint. Needs gcloud with run.invoker.

plugins.name: bms2
plugins.description: Query the Master Concept BMS operational database (orders, invoices, gross profit, POs, vendors, suppliers, products, billing cost, exchange rates, org chart) from its read-only BigQuery mirror. Read-only, no VPN.

plugins.name: mcai-webapp
plugins.description: Prompt → draft HTML → review → Google Apps Script web app with selectable access (org/gmail/anyone/private) → mcai.dev short link, with in-place updates that never change the URL.

plugins.name: mc-cms
plugins.description: Query Master Concept's Cloud MS reseller-management data — Google Cloud / Workspace billing accounts (status, master reseller, per customer), customers (org + domain), virtual customers and custom tiered SKU repricing, billing-account approvals, internal teams, and the CMS audit log — from its read-only BigQuery mirror behind a private Cloud Run endpoint. Read-only, skill-only: the agent signs a short-lived Google ID token with gcloud and curls the endpoint, so there is no MCP server, proxy or binary to install. Needs gcloud, logged in with an account that has Cloud Run run.invoker.
